title: ATC Communication - Audio 1
text: ATC Communication - Audio 1 ATC Communication - Audio 1.mp3 Information : Welcome to John F. Kennedy International Airport,The main international airport serving New York City. It’s about 8:40 pm local time on Friday, January 13, 2023. Ground and Tower air traffic controllers are busy managing the movement of the many aircraft departing from and arriving into JFK. Two departing aircraft are Delta Air Lines Flight 1943, destined for Santo Domingo in the Dominican Republic with 145 passengers on board, and American Airlines Flight 106, destined for London with 137 passengers on board.Near MissThe crew of American 106 have missed their right turn onto K and believe they have permission to cross the runway in front of them – runway 4L – which is currently an active takeoff runway.Possible Pilot DeviationPilot Deviations, or PDs, are the actions of a pilot that result in the violation of a Federal Aviation Regulation or a North American Aerospace Defense tolerance. This includes actions of a pilot that result in a failure to comply with an ATC clearance and/or instruction. PDs are typically investigated by Flight Standards field offices.OutroThe crew of Delta 1943 elect to return to a gate. With no staff available to crew the aircraft, the flight is delayed until the following morning. It arrived in Santo Domingo with a delay of about 14 hours. American 106 taxied to runway 31L and departed for London. Exercise :1. Where is John F.
